title: Coefficient and shift calculus for projection-trace adjoint transposes
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell
e p$, and finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation rings and uniformizers [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. For $W=X,Y$ put $R_{E,W}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$ and $\mathbf1_{E,W}=R_{E,W}[0]$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the derived-complete integral constructible categories and their full uniform finite-Tor subcategories $\mathscr D_E(W)=D^b_{ctf}(W,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], with normalized reduction towers [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Write $L_E=Lf_E^*$, $P_E=Rf_{!,E}$, $G_E=Rf_E^!$, $T_E=\mathbf1_{E,X}(d)[2d]$ and $H_EK=L_EK(d)[2d]$, using completed pullback and tensor, the integral compact-support functor, its specified exceptional adjunction with counit $\epsilon_E$, and Tate twists [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Use exactness and linearity in [def-weil-triangulated-category, def-weil-linear-functor]. For $E\subset F$ put $C_{F/E,W}(M)=M\otimes^L_{R_{E,W}}R_{F,W}$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], identified with strict-tower extension by $\chi$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison].
Use the natural comparisons $a_{F/E}:C_{F/E,X}H_E\xrightarrow{\sim}H_FC_{F/E,Y}$ induced by pullback, tensor, twist and shift, and $c_{F/E}:C_{F/E,Y}P_E\xrightarrow{\sim}P_FC_{F/E,X}$ of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison]. Assume $a$ has the ordinary tensor unit and associator equations and commutes with shifts. Let $t_E:P_ET_E\to\mathbf1_{E,Y}$ be any family of integral traces satisfying
$$t_F P_F(q_{F/E})c_{F/E,T_E}=C_{F/E,Y}(t_E),$$
where $q_{F/E}:C_{F/E,X}T_E\xrightarrow{\sim}T_F$ is $a$ at the unit. No finite-reduction normalization or invertibility of the traces is assumed. Put $u_{E,K}=(t_E\widehat\otimes1)\operatorname{PF}_{T_E,K}^{-1}$ and $\gamma_{E,K}=\operatorname{adj}_E(u_{E,K})j_{E,K}$, with $j_{E,K}:H_EK\xrightarrow{\sim}T_E\widehat\otimes^LL_EK$ the canonical reassociation and symmetry [def-exchange-projection, fix-prop-projection-formula]. Write $\widetilde u_{E,K}=u_{E,K}P_E(j_{E,K})$. Define
$$b_{F/E,K}=\operatorname{adj}_F\bigl(C_{F/E,Y}(\epsilon_{E,K})c_{F/E,G_EK}^{-1}\bigr):C_{F/E,X}G_EK\longrightarrow G_FC_{F/E,Y}K.$$
Then $b$ is natural and
$$\widetilde u_{F,C_{F/E,Y}K}P_F(a_{F/E,K})c_{F/E,H_EK}=C_{F/E,Y}(\widetilde u_{E,K}),\qquad b_{F/E,K}C_{F/E,X}(\gamma_{E,K})=\gamma_{F,C_{F/E,Y}K}a_{F/E,K}.$$
Under the tensor associator $\alpha^W_{L,F,E}$, the maps $b$ satisfy
$$b_{L/E,K}\alpha^X_{L,F,E,G_EK}=G_L(\alpha^Y_{L,F,E,K})b_{L/F,C_{F/E,Y}K}C_{L/F,X}(b_{F/E,K}),$$
and $b_{E/E}=1$. Equip $G_E$ with the counit-characterized adjunction shift comparison for the exact functor $P_E$. Assume moreover that, under the canonical tensor, projection and adjunction shift comparisons, $u_{E,K[1]}=u_{E,K}[1]$ and $\operatorname{adj}_E(u_{E,K[1]})=\operatorname{adj}_E(u_{E,K})[1]$ for all $E$ and $K$. Then $\gamma_{E,K[1]}=\gamma_{E,K}[1]$ and $b_{F/E,K[1]}=b_{F/E,K}[1]$. Here $j$ uses the even shift $[2d]$, including its Koszul sign $(-1)^{2d}=1$. If all $\gamma_{E,K}$ are invertible, then all $b_{F/E,K}$ are invertible, $G_E$ is exact on $\mathscr D_E(Y)$, and the displayed coefficient equality is an equality of natural transformations compatible with unit, composition and shift.

proof.text:
Write $Q_EK=T_E\widehat\otimes^LL_EK$. Composition is right to left, and all tensor unit constraints are understood. For $h:M\to G_EK$, its inverse adjunction transpose is $\epsilon_{E,K}P_E(h)$. Consequently $\epsilon_{E,K}P_E(\gamma_{E,K})=\widetilde u_{E,K}$ and
$$\epsilon_{F,C_YK}P_F(b_{F/E,K})=C_Y(\epsilon_{E,K})c_{F/E,G_EK}^{-1}.$$
Here and in Steps 2-4, $C_X=C_{F/E,X}$ and $C_Y=C_{F/E,Y}$. By [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], $b$ is the natural mate of $c^{-1}$, with $L_1=P_E,L_2=P_F,G=C_X,H=C_Y$. Naturality of the projection formula [fix-prop-projection-formula], tensoring the fixed $t_E$, and the natural adjunction bijection show that $u_E$ and $\gamma_E$ are natural in $K$. No component is assumed invertible. In Lean, lift the root-line and unit isomorphisms through the full inclusion using integralScalar_eq. The sourceComparison_existsUnique construction remains an original hole with its stated scalar/tensor/pullback proof plan. Naturality of the projection map, functoriality of tensor, and naturality of the left unitor prove ordinaryTrace naturality; transport by R.left and the adjunction homEquiv to obtain gamma_natural. The mate counit equation follows from Mathlib mateEquiv_counit.

source.place: Step 2, finite-coefficient-stage independence: explicit adjunction/projection calculation supplying the scalar-extension compatibility

proof.text:
Let $v:C_Y(P_ET_E\widehat\otimes^LK)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_Y(P_ET_E)\widehat\otimes^LC_YK$ be the tensor comparison. Let $r:C_XQ_EK\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_F(C_YK)$ be the tensor/pullback comparison followed by $q_{F/E}\widehat\otimes1$, and put $D=(P_F(q_{F/E})c_{F/E,T_E}\widehat\otimes1)v$. The projection-intertwining clause of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison], followed by naturality of [fix-prop-projection-formula] in $T$, says exactly
$$P_F(r)c_{F/E,Q_EK}C_Y(\operatorname{PF}_{T_E,K})=\operatorname{PF}_{T_F,C_YK}D.$$
Both projection maps are isomorphisms on the stated finite-Tor inputs. Multiply by their inverses and by $t_F\widehat\otimes1$. The trace hypothesis gives $(t_F\widehat\otimes1)D=C_Y(t_E\widehat\otimes1)$ after the tensor unit identifications. Substitution yields
$$u_{F,C_YK}P_F(r)c_{F/E,Q_EK}=C_Y(u_{E,K}).$$

source.place: Step 2, finite-coefficient-stage independence: explicit adjunction/projection calculation supplying the scalar-extension compatibility

proof.text:
The specified tensor normalization of $a$ gives $r\,C_X(j_{E,K})=j_{F,C_YK}a_{F/E,K}$: both composites first extend $L_EK$, the twist line and the shift, and then place the twist line on the left using the same symmetry and associator. Naturality of $c$ [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] at $j_{E,K}$ gives $c_{Q_EK}C_Y(P_Ej_{E,K})=P_F(C_Xj_{E,K})c_{H_EK}$. Precompose Step 2 by $C_Y(P_Ej_{E,K})$ and substitute these two identities. This is the first asserted equation
$$\widetilde u_{F,C_YK}P_F(a_{F/E,K})c_{F/E,H_EK}=C_Y(\widetilde u_{E,K}).$$

source.place: Step 2, finite-coefficient-stage independence: explicit adjunction/projection calculation supplying the scalar-extension compatibility

proof.text:
Compare the two maps from $C_XH_EK$ to $G_FC_YK$ by their inverse adjunction transposes [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. The transpose of $b_{F/E,K}C_X(\gamma_{E,K})$ is
$$C_Y(\epsilon_{E,K})c_{G_EK}^{-1}P_F(C_X\gamma_{E,K})=C_Y(\epsilon_{E,K}P_E\gamma_{E,K})c_{H_EK}^{-1}=C_Y(\widetilde u_{E,K})c_{H_EK}^{-1},$$
where the first equality is naturality of $c$ [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison]. The transpose of $\gamma_{F,C_YK}a_{F/E,K}$ is $\widetilde u_{F,C_YK}P_F(a_{F/E,K})$, the same map by Step 3. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection proves the coefficient square.

proof.text:
Under the stated canonical shift comparisons, reassociation and symmetry give $j_{E,K[1]}=j_{E,K}[1]$. The only sign from moving the extra shift $[1]$ past the displayed shift $[2d]$ is $(-1)^{2d}=1$; the degree-zero Tate line contributes no further sign. By the hypothesis on the particular transposes of $u_E$, we therefore have
$$\gamma_{E,K[1]}=\operatorname{adj}_E(u_{E,K})[1]j_{E,K}[1]=\gamma_{E,K}[1].$$
This uses the explicit shift hypothesis of the item, not a claim that an arbitrary natural transformation of exact functors respects shift. In the formal source coordinates, gamma is definitionally adjunction.homEquiv of integrated, so this conclusion is precisely the second conjunct of TraceShiftCompatible.
